# PHASE-007 - Deliver the local visual authoring workbench

## Objective

Provide real editing and reviewed publication in a usable browser interface.

## Scope

- Trusted local service
- Graph/list exploration and editing
- Review, conflict preservation and accessibility

## Entry conditions

- Guarded publication and durable proposal APIs are available.

## Exit criteria

- Search, edit, validate, review and permitted publication use real backend interfaces.
- Browser-origin, actor and stale-review attacks fail without losing drafts.

## Risks

- Local listening does not by itself authenticate an actor or protect against cross-origin requests.

## TASK-033 - Implement the trusted local workbench service

Add a loopback server and trusted CLI/agent session bootstrap that delegates each request to existing read/proposal/guarded mutation interfaces.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-027, REQ-029, REQ-032 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_workbench.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_workbench_security.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-032, TASK-015 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Current local cooperative native checks are not OS authentication; disclose the boundary.

### Acceptance criteria

- Default listening is loopback only; session identity/scope comes from trusted server-side current authority, never browser actor/grant JSON.
- Origin/Host, CSRF, stale token, traversal, symlink, executable label/import and unauthorized resource cases fail.

### Planned verification

- Probe actual local endpoints from permitted and hostile origins with current/stale/forged sessions.
- Verify session secrets stay out of logs, canonical files and durable evidence.

### Risks

- Keep the interface local and understandable; expose implementation detail only when needed for a decision.

## TASK-035 - Implement supported draft authoring

Add forms and graph actions for concepts, definitions, aliases, properties, relations, constraints and source bindings through the durable proposal API.

| Dependencies | TASK-034 |
| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Draft edits do not publish or expand source/read/write scope.

### Acceptance criteria

- Users can create/edit supported records, validate and see a semantic diff without editing JSON.
- Locked imports resist modification; deprecation/replacement preserves old identities and unsupported destruction is rejected.

### Planned verification

- Create/edit a concept and relation through the real service and reopen the saved draft.
- Exercise locked core content, unsupported fields, invalid endpoints and replacement history.

## TASK-036 - Connect browser review to real advanced operations

Expose query/inference inspection, candidate evidence/impact, AI request preparation and captured proposal review, rejection/revision and guarded publication.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-008, REQ-012, REQ-016, REQ-018, REQ-029, REQ-032 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/workbench/review.js, SKILLS-depo/ontology/workbench/advanced.js |
| Dependencies | TASK-035 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not report a queued generator or publication request as completed.

### Acceptance criteria

- Browser actions use the same advanced/proposal/publisher APIs and exact hashes as CLI/agent clients.
- Validation, draft saving and review clicks remain separate from current authorization and actual publication.
- Published results are reopened and display the actual receipt/partial state; missing generator/backend states are truthful.

### Planned verification

- Exercise actual SPARQL/inference inspection and a captured native proposal in the browser.
- Publish a permitted exact change and reject unauthorized/stale requests, inspecting canonical bytes.

## TASK-037 - Preserve user work through concurrent and failed operations

Add optimistic draft revision checks, conflict presentation, safe cancel/discard and reloadable revisions with truthful partial-publication state.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-016, REQ-018, REQ-030, REQ-031 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/workbench/editor.js, SKILLS-depo/ontology/workbench/review.js, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_workbench_conflicts.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-036 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Recovery must reuse the accepted operation, not submit a second logical publication.

### Acceptance criteria

- Two clients cannot silently overwrite the same target or approved review.
- Validation/backend/publish failures preserve unpublished content and identify committed versus pending changes.

### Planned verification

- Use two browser sessions to race saves and publication; reopen both drafts.
- Inject validation/backend/partial publication failure and verify cancel/discard preserves canonical content.
